summary: Dilevalol was pulled from the market worldwide starting in 1990 because of harm to the liver [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated low risk scores for liver and heart harm [M]. Other medications with similar chemical structures have caused heart harm, breathing issues, or were pulled from the market in places like the United Kingdom and European Union [4][5][6]. Three clinical studies linked to the search were stopped early due to issues like slow patient sign-ups or the lead researcher leaving [7][8][9][10].
